assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina, GPL21290) of PBMC total RNA, human
sample_inclusion: 117 GEO samples: GWI T0/T1/T2 = 20/18/20, HC T0/T1/T2 = 19/20/20 (GEO source_name counts)
repeated_measure_unit: participant (each subject sampled at T0, T1, T2); GEO gives no explicit subject key
primary_estimand: Exercise (stress) response of the PBMC transcriptome over time within GWI patients and within healthy controls (T1 vs T0, T2 vs T0, T2 vs T1), and how the response differs between GWI and controls; plus GWI vs HC at each time point
planned_contrasts: within GWI: T1 vs T0, T2 vs T0 (exercise response; abstract MAIN METHODS; exact contrast list not stated in abstract)
within HC: T1 vs T0, T2 vs T0
GWI vs HC at T0, T1, T2 (disease contrast, not an exercise effect)
paper_method: DESeq2 on HTSeq/STAR raw counts separately for GSNAP, HISAT2 and STAR alignments; DEXSeq for exons (GEO data_processing)
normalization: DESeq2 size factors; genes kept if raw count >= 10 in all samples of at least one group (GEO data_processing)

paper_threshold.note: multi-aligner consensus: FC>|1.5| & FDR<0.10 in one aligner and FC>|1.4| & FDR<0.15 in the other two, OR FC>|1.5| & FDR<0.10 in two of three aligners (GSNAP, HISAT2, STAR). Only HISAT2 counts are deposited as a matrix, so the consensus rule cannot be reproduced; the single-aligner part (FC 1.5 -> |log2FC| > 0.5849625, FDR < 0.10) is the nearest.

paper_results: Abstract only: dysregulated immune and inflammatory pathways in GWI; no DEG counts or gene names in the abstract.
